newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond futures end higher, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: French bond futures end higher, more gains seen.

text.p: 1523 GMT - 10-yr bond futures, PIBOR settle sharply higher on market relief at government deficit-cutting package which analysts say bullish for EMU. Market helped by firmness of T-bond ahead of Greenspan testimony. Ffr gains vs mark
*5.50 2007 OAT yield 5.39 pct vs 5.43. Bund spd -15 bp vs -13
*Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Sept PIBOR 96.57, up 0.7 bp
